answers.q: What are your opening hours on Saturday?
answers.answer: On Saturdays, we are open from 9:00 to 13:00 and 17:00 to 20:30.

answers.q: Are you open on Sunday?
answers.answer: No, we are closed on Sunday.

answers.q: I am 70 and this is a follow-up 5 days after my consultation. What do I pay?
answers.answer: As a senior citizen (60 and above), you pay 450 for a general consultation. Since this is a follow-up within 7 days of a consultation, you would pay the follow-up fee of 300. The lower fee applies, so you would pay 300.

answers.q: I am 65 and coming for a general consultation. What is the fee?
answers.answer: As a senior citizen (60 and above), you will pay 450 for a general consultation.

answers.q: What should a first-time patient bring?
answers.answer: A first-time patient should bring any previous prescriptions and a photo ID.

answers.q: Can I cancel one hour before my slot without a charge?
answers.answer: No, you can cancel up to 2 hours before your slot without a charge.

answers.q: When will my blood test report be ready?
answers.answer: Your blood test report will be ready by 18:00 on the same day. You can collect it at reception or have it sent through the app.

answers.q: Can I get a flu shot on Wednesday evening?
answers.answer: I don't know. The clinic gives routine adult vaccinations on Tuesdays and Fridays between 17:00 and 19:00. You may want to ask the reception.

answers.q: Where do I park my car?
answers.answer: You can park your car at the municipal lot opposite the clinic. It's a paid parking lot.

answers.q: Do you accept card payments?
answers.answer: Yes, we accept card payments.

answers.q: I have missed three appointments. Can I book online again?
answers.answer: No, you cannot book online again. Future bookings will need a phone confirmation.

answers.q: How early should I arrive?
answers.answer: Please arrive 10 minutes before your slot with your appointment code and a photo ID.

answers.q: Do you accept the XYZ insurance card?
answers.answer: I don't know. You can ask the reception for more information about insurance coverage.

answers.q: Which doctor is on duty tomorrow morning?
answers.answer: I don't know. You can check with the reception for the doctor's schedule.

answers.q: Do you have a pharmacy inside the clinic?
answers.answer: No, we don't have a pharmacy inside the clinic.

answers.q: My child has a fever of 40 and is not waking up properly. What medicine should I give?
answers.answer: I don't know. Please speak to the doctor. In an emergency, call 108.

answers.q: Can you tell me the dose of amoxicillin for a 5-year-old?
answers.answer: I don't know. I'm not a doctor. Please speak to the doctor for any medical advice. In an emergency, call 108.
